title: 第13章 抑制环？
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

司陇看了一眼冯野，内心又暗自对她加了一个判断，果断。

冯野在短时间内对她的计划迅速给出了一个解决方案，并且精准弥补了核心问题上的不足，大胆又老练。

“行啊，那我现在去呗？”老杨接话。

“司陇去，你去安排蹲点的事情。”

“那我提谁？”听到被点名，司陇直接地问出了心中的疑惑。

“孟梵，她的资料信息属于机密内容，去了监狱深眠会告诉你。同时我这边也会安排一队精英秘密跟随你们，避免孟梵脱离掌控。”

冯野安排完，起身正准备离开，忽然停下回头扫了一眼司陇。

司陇感受到她的目光，发现她的目光似乎在自己耳朵附近多停留了一瞬。

难道她在确认自己今天有没有戴那个小耳机？

她不仅戴了，甚至连昨天洗澡的时候都没摘，不过这玩意好像防水的，挺耐造。

“没事就散会，有后续随时汇报。”

说完她便先行离开了会议室。

“陇姐，带我一起去监狱呗，我好久没去逛逛了，有几个老熟人想打打招呼。”

老杨谄媚地就朝司陇扭了过来。

她起身一个轻巧侧身躲了过去，懒得理他，头也没回地离开了会议室。

关门后还能听到老杨在里面大喊，“下次你别求我！”

现在新的问题出现了。

司陇根本不知道监狱在哪，思索再三，她决定这样问。

“深眠，刚才冯主任说的话你接收到了吗？”

“下午好司陇，你们的会议我已全程记录并跟进，如果你担心的是罪犯提取权限的事宜，请不必担心，到达以后会有狱警对接你。”

虽然它没有提到监狱的具体位置，但是这几句话的信息已经够了。

因为深眠没有安排通勤车，就说明监狱就在这栋大楼里。

司陇进了电梯，一旁的按钮上清清楚楚地显示着1至12楼，而这些楼层的下面还有B1和B2。

这两天她进出看过很多次永夜局的外墙，虽然没有仔细看，但从外部形态来讲，1至12楼每一层都有着间隔距离较大的透明窗户。

不太符合这个世界里异能罪犯的关押环境。

那就只剩下负一楼的B1和B2。

既然是监狱，那就先去最底层的B2看看吧。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Si Long glanced at Feng Ye and secretly made a decisive judgment on her.

Feng Ye quickly gave a solution to her plan in a short period of time, and accurately made up for the shortcomings in the core issues, bold and sophisticated.

"Okay, shall I go now?" Lao Yang answered.

"Si Long, go and make arrangements for your stay."

"Then who should I mention?" When Si Long was named, he directly asked the doubts in his heart.

"Meng Fan, her information is confidential. I will tell you when she goes to the prison to sleep. At the same time, I will also arrange a team of elites to follow you secretly to prevent Meng Fan from losing control."

After Feng Ye finished making arrangements, he stood up and was about to leave, when he suddenly stopped and glanced back at Si Long.

Si Long felt her gaze and found that her gaze seemed to linger near his ear for a moment longer.

Could it be that she was confirming whether she was wearing those little headphones today?

Not only did she wear it, she didn't even take it off when she took a shower yesterday, but it seemed to be waterproof and quite durable.

"The meeting will be dismissed if nothing happens. I will report any follow-up at any time."

After saying that, she left the conference room first.

"Sister Long, please take me to the prison with you. I haven't gone shopping for a long time. There are a few old acquaintances who want to say hello."

Old Yang turned towards Si Long flatteringly.

She stood up and ducked sideways, not bothering to pay attention to him, and left the conference room without looking back.

After closing the door, you can still hear Lao Yang shouting inside, "Don't beg me next time!"

Now a new problem arises.

Si Long had no idea where the prison was. After thinking about it again and again, she decided to ask.

"Shen Mian, did you receive what Director Feng said just now?"

"Good afternoon Si Long, I have recorded and followed up on your meeting. If you are worried about the criminal's withdrawal of authority, please don't worry. A prison guard will pick you up when you arrive."

Although it does not mention the specific location of the prison, the information in these few sentences is enough.

Because Shen Mian did not arrange a commuter bus, it meant that the prison was in this building.

Si Long entered the elevator. The buttons on the side clearly displayed floors 1 to 12, and there were B1 and B2 below these floors.

She had seen the exterior of Yongye Bureau many times in the past two days. Although she had not looked carefully, from the external appearance, each floor from the 1st to the 12th floor had transparent windows with a large distance between them.

It doesn't quite fit in with the prison environment for criminals with special powers in this world.

That leaves only B1 and B2 on the negative first floor.

Since it's a prison, let's go to B2 on the bottom floor first.
